name: chandra54-art-marketplace
description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace. Currently ships the 'reflect' and 'engineering-skills' plugins, vendored (MIT, unmodified) from alirezarezvani/claude-skills. For the full 300+ skill library these were drawn from, also run `/plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills`.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Mid-conversation reflection skill that pauses execution and zooms out from detail-mode to honestly reassess direction, assumptions, and bias against the original goal.

plugins.name: engineering-skills
plugins.description: 32 production-ready engineering skills: architecture, frontend, backend, fullstack, QA, DevOps, security (adversarial-reviewer, ai-security, cloud-security, incident-response, red-team, threat-detection), AI/ML, data engineering, Stripe integration, TDD guide, a11y, Snowflake, and senior-* specialist skills (frontend/backend/fullstack/devops/qa/security/data/ml/etc.).
